reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already exports getExpectedScheduleAmount (missing -> 0, number, range endpoint furthest from zero), used by posting and preview, and the diff does not call it.

duplication.why: The nested ternary in scheduleModel.toExternal is a line-for-line copy of getExpectedScheduleAmount's body.

placement.why: Adding the field in the API model mapper is the right layer, but the amount rule itself belongs to the shared schedules helper, not inline in the mapper.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and a new test are touched.

maintainability.why: The API's expectedAmount will silently diverge from what Actual posts and previews the next time the expected-amount rule changes, which is exactly what the request wanted to prevent.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes the expected amount itself instead of calling getExpectedScheduleAmount (shared/schedules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The copy is verbatim (same null/number/abs-comparison structure), only written as one ternary chain; it is not disguised.
